Hyprbars source from https://github.com/hyprwm/hyprland-plugins

Upstream snapshot: `7644cecdb947060682891a0db2a0cdc5c0b9e704` (the official pin for Hyprland 0.56.2).

`main.cpp` is the locally adapted version used to build this laptop's plugin,
including Lua configuration support. Other source files come from the upstream
snapshot. This combined source must be rebuilt for the target Hyprland ABI.
See the accompanying upstream license.
